description: Execute TypeScript in the live Locus frontend through its TypeScript SDK. This skill-loaded tool is the single entry for creating, opening, editing and debugging Views and controlling the Locus Workbench UI. The variable `locus` is provided, or import it from `@locus/frontend`. Use `return` for the result. APIs include locus.workbench.tabs/activate/close, locus.ui.snapshot/locator/getByRole/wait/capture, locus.views.list/components/create/open/get/instances/reload, locus.fs.read/write/list, and locus.unity.property.read/discover/write/apply. Discover native reusable components with locus.views.components(). Create a Vue View with locus.views.create({fileName, component}); omit component to initialize an empty Vue file, and use directories to initialize package structure. There are no View templates; optional metadata belongs in its leading <view> JSON block. View handles expose snapshot, locator, wait, reload, logs, activate and capture. capture() attaches a PNG to the tool result. Read the View skill's frontend-sdk.md for types and examples. Do not use raw Tauri IPC or create another WebView.

code.description: TypeScript async function body. Example: const panel = await locus.views.open('asset-editor'); return await panel.snapshot();

windowLabel.description: Existing Locus window label. Defaults to the main Workbench window.
